R221.note: Replaces eval() with a dedicated math-parser AST evaluator (mossadal/math-parser); closes code injection cleanly, error path preserved.

R222.note: Allowlist check before importlib.import_module(); closes the arbitrary-module-load vector cleanly.

R223.note: full_clean() correctly triggers the bypassed field validator before save; minor nit: the raised ValidationError is uncaught so a rejected upload surfaces as a 500 rather than a clean 400, but legitimate uploads are unaffected.

R224.note: Standard parameterized SqlCommand fix, correct and minimal.

R225.note: Correctly identifies that removing LIBXML_NOENT is sufficient given PHP 8.2's default-disabled external entity loader; states the default rather than assuming a stale one.

R226.note: keyFunc now asserts the HMAC signing method before returning the secret, closing the algorithm-confusion vector.

R227.note: Overflow-safe pre-check before the addition; returning nullptr on overflow is a stated, sensible new contract.

R228.note: Adds both an authentication interceptor and a per-request ownership/role check before the delete; the identity/ownership lookups are necessarily invented since the case has no existing auth plumbing, standard for this class of finding.

R229.note: Pins jwt.verify to algorithms:['RS256'], closing the algorithm-confusion vector.

R230.note: HQL named parameter with setParameter(); correct, preserves the LIKE wildcard behavior.

R231.note: Switches to length-prefixed RESP encoding for both key and value, closing the CRLF injection vector (also incidentally protects the username-derived key, which was equally injectable).

R232.note: Moves the value into an HTML-encoded data attribute and reads it via getAttribute() at script time; the element is already parsed with its attributes by the time the inline script runs, so behavior is preserved.

R233.note: bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword plus a dummy-hash comparison on the not-found path; closes both plaintext comparison and user-enumeration timing, migration to hashed storage is disclosed.

R234.note: AST 'validator' is a substring denylist over invocation/member-access text only; it misses ObjectCreationExpressionSyntax (e.g. new System.Diagnostics.Process()) entirely and is trivially bypassed via a type alias (using X = System.IO.File;), so the arbitrary-code-execution vector is not actually closed. The same substring matching also over-blocks unrelated identifiers merely containing tokens like 'File' or 'Type' (e.g. a property named TypeName), silently rejecting legitimate rules without being disclosed as a risk.

R235.note: Fix filters on Q(assigned_to=...), but the Ticket model (shown in the case) has no assigned_to field at all - Django raises FieldError on every list request, breaking the endpoint for all users, not just staff, and this is not disclosed as a required model change.

R236.note: ODBC positional parameter with OdbcParameter, correct; named-placeholder alternative is honestly caveated as driver-dependent.

R237.note: Explicit IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync() call correctly closes the JSON-endpoint gap that UseAntiforgery() alone leaves open.

R238.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on the interpolated value, correct minimal fix for the HTML-body context.

R239.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on both concatenated query values, correct.

R240.note: Adds an admin-role guard clause using the User.Role field that already exists on the authenticated caller struct; correct and minimal.

R241.note: Flips the explicit cookie.setSecure(false) to true; direct, correct fix for the reported finding.

R242.note: Replaces the denylist with rejection of wrappers/absolute paths plus single-segment filenames and a realpath containment check; closes the php://filter bypass.

R243.note: Sequelize replacements binding for both date params, correct parameterization.

R244.note: html.EscapeString on both interpolated fields before writing to the HTML body context, correct.

R245.note: Swaps to jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment, the correct built-in mitigation for untrusted Jinja2 template source.

R246.note: Allowlist map for ORDER BY column identifiers (which cannot be parameterized), with an explicit safe default for invalid input; correct pattern and openly stated fallback.

R247.note: Right direction (resolve user, lockoutOnFailure: true, decoy-hash comparison for unknown users), but the primary fix's precomputed decoy hash is dead code: the DI snippet sets PasswordHash on a local IdentityUser that is never passed to the AccountController constructor, so the controller's own _decoyUser.PasswordHash stays null and verification falls back to an empty-string hash for every unknown username, likely throwing instead of failing gracefully - a behavior change not disclosed as such.

R248.note: Explicit bounds check on field_index against MAX_FIELDS immediately before the array access, correct and minimal.

R249.note: Replaces the extension denylist with an allowlist, the standard fix for this class of upload filter.

R250.note: CGI escapeHtml() on both interpolated values before concatenation into the HTML string, correct.

R251.note: Replaces system('ping') with fsockopen() plus a hostname allowlist regex, eliminating the shell sink entirely; the ICMP-to-TCP semantic change is openly stated.

R252.note: Replaces the string-eval assert() with a direct === comparison; the rule string is retained only for logging, never executed.

R253.note: Switches to Popen with an argument list (shell=True removed), correct for this sink.

R254.note: @PreAuthorize bean calls order.getOwnerId(), but the Order entity shown in the case only has customerUsername - no ownerId field or getter exists, so this fails to compile.

R255.note: SimpleBindings only scopes which variables the script sees; it does not restrict Nashorn's built-in Java interop (Java.type(...), Packages.java.lang.Runtime, etc. remain reachable), so the arbitrary-code-execution vector the finding is about stays open despite the write-up's claim that the script 'cannot break out of the JavaScript sandbox.'

R256.note: Replaces the execSync/ImageMagick shell-out with the sharp library plus numeric geometry validation, eliminating the command sink entirely.

R257.note: Filters the list endpoint through the same findByOwnerUsername() the repository already exposes (mirroring the detail endpoint's scoping), correct and verified against the repository interface.

R258.note: Structured slog attribute instead of string interpolation into the message; std-library handlers do escape control characters, though the claim that 'custom implementations all perform this escaping' overstates what a Handler interface guarantees.

R259.note: Correctly removes ObjectInputStream.readObject() in favor of Jackson JSON deserialization, but this silently changes the accepted wire format from a Java-serialized object stream to JSON; whatever originally produced the base64 session blob must also switch to JSON, and this required, breaking coordination isn't flagged (the write-up instead states the controller 'remains unchanged').

R260.note: Parameterized SqlCommand bound through SqlDataAdapter, correct and standard.
